description: Explicit whitelist of path-pattern to normalizer rule pairs for dual-stack JSON comparison. Global timestamp and float normalizations are strictly prohibited.

rules.justification: MongoDB generates unique, non-deterministic 24-character hex ObjectIds upon document creation on each stack independently.
Foreign key reference to newly created Worker ObjectId generated during write flows.
Foreign key reference to newly created Assignment ObjectId generated during write flows.
Foreign key reference to newly created Payment ObjectId generated during write flows.
Foreign key reference to newly created Bill ObjectId generated during write flows.
Foreign key reference to newly created Inventory Item ObjectId generated during write flows.
JWT signatures and issued-at timestamps (iat/jti) are dynamically computed per authentication request.
Unique request tracing UUID generated per HTTP request.
Timestamp recorded at the instant of write execution. Both stacks emit naive ISO 8601 (formatDjangoIso) but exact wall-clock second/microsecond differs between sequential HTTP calls.
Sequence number generated on invoice creation. Preserves prefix format while normalizing atomic sequence counter state across test runs.
